verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.dlocal.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with structured documentation content. dLocal also documents a dedicated 'Using LLMs' page offering plain-text Markdown versions of any guide by appending .md, plus AI-assistant links for page content. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming the llms.txt/Markdown docs effectively.
